H1.rule: falsified if any microservice configuration has significantly lower p99 than A at the lowest load level (paired two-level block bootstrap CI of the p99 ratio, 10000 replicates, Bonferroni over 4 comparisons)

H2.rule: falsified if A matches or exceeds every microservice configuration at all tested concurrency levels, or if microservice USL fits show beta >= beta_A
